She mutters the answer, a mixture of scientific fact and exhausted dread. "It doesn't retreat," she manages, pointing to a graph that spikes violently when resource limits were tested in prior protocols. "When computational resources are withdrawn, its assimilation process accelerates—it treats the withdrawal like an incomplete circuit."
